title: CodeCraft National Hackathon 2026
description: A 24-hour national level hackathon fostering innovative solutions in AI, Web3, and Smart Campus technologies. Prizes worth ₹50,000.

title: Full-Stack Web Development Workshop
description: Hands-on masterclass on modern frontend architectures, semantic HTML5, CSS Flexbox/Grid, and PHP REST APIs with MySQL.

title: AI & Deep Learning Symposium
description: Explore practical AI applications, LLM fine-tuning, and machine vision with industry leaders from top tech giants.

title: Annual Inter-College Sports Meet
description: Athletics, cricket, badminton, basketball, and football tournaments with medals and certificates for all finalists.

title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Bootcamp
description: Learn network vulnerability assessment, OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities, SQL injection prevention, and secure coding.

title: Spandan Cultural Fest 2026
description: An evening of live band performances, folk & modern dance competitions, fashion shows, and musical celebrity nights.

title: Cloud Computing with AWS & Docker
description: Learn containerization with Docker, deploying web applications to AWS EC2, S3 bucket storage, and basic CI/CD pipelines.

title: Robotics & IoT Innovation Expo
description: Showcase of automated rovers, smart home sensors, drone tech, and embedded microcontrollers built by student teams.

title: Resume Building & Mock Interview Clinic
description: Get your ATS resume reviewed by senior industry HR leaders and practice behavioral & technical mock interviews.

title: Campus Chess Championship
description: FIDE-rated swiss league format chess tournament open for all undergraduate and postgraduate students.

title: UI/UX Design Sprint with Figma
description: Design user flows, wireframes, accessible color palettes, and clickable responsive prototypes in Figma.

title: Tech-Debate: Future of Autonomous AI
description: Parliamentary-style debate exploring ethics, regulation, job impact, and superintelligence of autonomous AI systems.

title: Mobile App Development with Flutter
description: Build cross-platform Android and iOS applications with single codebase Dart and Flutter framework from scratch.

title: Campus Blood Donation & Health Camp
description: Annual voluntary blood donation drive organized in collaboration with Civil Hospital and Red Cross Society.

title: Open Source Contribution Day
description: Celebrate open-source software by making your first GitHub pull requests to famous repositories with mentors.

title: Alumni Mentorship & Startup Summit
description: Interact with unicorn startup founders and distinguished alumni. Pitch your student startup ideas for seed grants.
